left join ( select a.review_user_id,a.review_user_name,count(1) num from ( select o.review_user_id,o.review_user_name,o.orgId,o.survey_info_id from ( select o.review_user_id,o.review_user_name,(case f.`level` when 1 then f.id else f.parent_id end) as orgId,o.survey_info_id,r.survey_no,o.org_survey_state,o.report_date,o.review_time from survey_assign_org o left join survey_franchisee f on o.survey_org_id = f.id left join survey_risk_case_info r on o.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where o.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0 and o.review_time is not null and n.org_attr = 2

) o group by o.review_user_id,o.orgId,o.survey_info_id HAVING max(o.org_survey_state) = min(o.org_survey_state) and max(o.org_survey_state) = 4 and DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(max(o.report_date),INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') < DATE_FORMAT(max(o.review_time),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and DATE_FORMAT(max(o.review_time),'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(max(o.review_time),'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
) a group by a.review_user_id ) c on a.user_id = c.review_user_id

and find_in_set(r.entrust_org_id,#{entrustOrgIds,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

and DATE_FORMAT(r.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by o.review_user_id ) e on a.user_id = e.review_user_id left join ( select a.review_user_id,a.review_user_name,count(1) num from ( select t.review_user_id,t.review_user_name,t.orgId,t.survey_info_id from ( select o.review_user_id,o.review_user_name,(case f.`level` when 1 then f.id else f.parent_id end) as orgId,o.survey_info_id,r.survey_no,o.org_survey_state from survey_assign_org o left join survey_franchisee f on o.survey_org_id = f.id left join survey_risk_case_info r on o.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where o.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0 and o.review_time is not null and n.org_attr = 2 AND r.entrust_report_end_date IS NOT NULL and DATE_FORMAT(r.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(r.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
) t group by t.review_user_id,t.orgId,t.survey_info_id HAVING max(t.org_survey_state) = min(t.org_survey_state) and max(t.org_survey_state) = 4 ) a group by a.review_user_id ) f on a.user_id = f.review_user_id left join ( select a.review_user_id,a.review_user_name,count(1) num,SUM(a.basScore)basScore,SUM(a.sunScore)sunScore,SUM(a.totalScore)totalScore from ( select t.review_user_id,t.review_user_name,t.orgId,t.survey_info_id,t.basScore,t.sunScore,t.totalScore from ( select o.id,o.review_user_id,o.review_user_name,(case f.`level` when 1 then f.id else f.parent_id end) as orgId,o.survey_info_id,r.survey_no,o.org_survey_state,sum(ifnull(c.assess_score,0)) - sum(ifnull(c.assess_sun_score,0)) as basScore,sum(ifnull(c.assess_sun_score,0)) as sunScore,sum(ifnull(c.assess_score,0)) as totalScore from survey_assign_org o left join survey_franchisee f on o.survey_org_id = f.id left join survey_risk_case_info r on o.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id LEFT JOIN survey_investigator_case c ON c.survey_info_id = r.id where o.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0 and n.org_attr = 2 AND c.delete_flag = 0 AND c.survey_org_id = o.survey_org_id AND r.entrust_report_end_date IS NOT NULL and DATE_FORMAT(r.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(r.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
